svg.title: tsrs vs TypeScript 7.1 beta
svg.desc: Each compiler with its default settings on an Apple M4 Pro (12 cores); median of 10 interleaved runs (5 for TypeScript). t3code-server: check time tsrs --fast 1.32 s, 4.9× faster; tsrs (default) 1.70 s, 3.8× faster; TypeScript 7.1 beta 6.47 s. peak memory tsrs --fast 1.84 GiB, 2.3× less; tsrs (default) 1.82 GiB, 2.3× less; TypeScript 7.1 beta 4.17 GiB. vscode: check time tsrs --fast 2.01 s, 2.5× faster; tsrs (default) 2.89 s, 1.7× faster;
